AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Controls the user's robot vacuum (running Valetudo) over the home network: starts cleaning rooms, the whole home or saved presets, pauses, resumes, stops, sends it to its dock, finds it and reports its status. Operational patterns: - For 'clean the kitchen' style requests call 'cleanRooms' with the room names as the user said them; names are matched leniently and across languages. - If 'cleanRooms' reports an unknown room, call 'listRooms' and ask the user which room they meant. - For named routines such as 'after dinner' call 'listPresets' if unsure, then 'startPreset'. - Use 'getRobotStatus' to answer questions about the robot or the battery. Constraints: - Only one job runs at a time; a busy robot must be paused, stopped or sent home first. Ask the user before stopping a running job. - The robot is only reachable while the phone is on the same network.
